facts.fact: The Ministry of National Solidarity said a pilot of its unified digital platform, covering electronic registration for the AFS allowance and the national digital card for persons with special needs, was being tested in Dar El Beida and Hussein Dey until 31 March 2026, with database integration and interconnectivity under verification.
